question.text: After how many years from the date of investment does a PMS exit become free of exit load?

explanation.text: The Logic: After a period of three years from the date of investment, no exit load applies under the PMS exit-load schedule. The Trap: Exits within the first three years from the date of investment still attract exit load under the prescribed schedule. Note: The three-year cut-off is measured from the date of investment under the PMS exit-load framework.
